subject.title: [Bug]: Non-main agent may miss models.json and fail with "Unknown model" when provider plan is empty

question: Should the missing non-main models.json skip path be fixed by one-time bootstrap from the default agent, read-through inheritance, or an early actionable failure?
rationale: Repository policy treats fallback behavior and provider/auth catalog state as compatibility-sensitive, and the available linked PRs choose different boundaries with different upgrade and credential implications.

options.title: Land narrow bootstrap fix
options.body: Rebase/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/58373 or an equivalent replacement that only creates a missing non-main models.json and never overwrites existing per-agent catalogs.

options.title: Prefer read-through inheritance
options.body: Use the catalog-inheritance direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90903 only if it is extended to cover this missing-root-file case without unsafe provider config mixing.

options.title: Fail early with guidance
options.body: Add an actionable startup/session error instead of copying or inheriting catalogs if maintainers decide persistent fallback behavior is the wrong product boundary.

recommendation.title: Land narrow bootstrap fix
recommendation.body: Rebase/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/58373 or an equivalent replacement that only creates a missing non-main models.json and never overwrites existing per-agent catalogs.

likelyOwner.reason: Local current-main history points to this author across the central agent model config and registry paths, making them the best available routing owner for the product-boundary choice.
